name: rm
description: Remove (unlink) the FILE(s). By default does not remove directories.

options.description: Remove directories and their contents recursively.
Ignore nonexistent files and arguments, never prompt.

examples.title: Recursively force remove a directory
examples.explanation: Deletes build directory and all its contents without prompting.

warnings: Using rm -rf without caution can instantly delete critical system files if run with root privileges.
